function.name: Horcrux

misc.desc: 強化後作為狗糧，可折算的經驗值比例（只對狗糧自身擁有的經驗計算
強化時，所消耗的金幣為提升經驗值的倍數
眾神試煉精神力多少秒回復1點
精神力可購買次數上限（前端暫時屏蔽該功能）
每次自動戰鬥可一次性進行的最大次數
每自動挑戰一關所花費的時間/分鐘

suits.attr_4_desc: When hits an enemy whose max HP is greater, increase Armor Ingored by10+0.2* your Physical Def, increase Spell Penetra by 10+0.2* your Spell Resist
suits.name: Skylight

suits.attr_4_desc: Every 8 damages received, the next damage received will be returned to the damage dealler. CD: 3 seconds.
suits.name: RailFire Eyes

suits.attr_4_desc: When making a critical strike, add additional damage of your 5% of your current HP + 1% of the enemy's max HP, the upper limit is 100,000, CD: 6 seconds.
suits.name: Chronological

suits.attr_4_desc: Every time 30% of the max HP damage is received, the enemy within a certain range will be stunned.
suits.name: Nucleus

suits.attr_4_desc: The duration of negative state released by your own will be extended by 20%, and the armor and magic resistance of the enemy in a specific negative state will be reduced by 50 points.
suits.name: Wild Rope

suits.attr_4_desc: When the HP is lower than 20%, it will enter the invincible state for 3 seconds, and restore 3% of max HP per second within 10 seconds (can only be triggered once).
suits.name: Peace Song

suits.attr_4_desc: When attacking, it will add 12% damage to the target's lost HP, the upper limit is 50000, CD: 10 seconds.
suits.name: Reincarnation

suits.attr_4_desc: At the beginning of the battle, restore 100 energy for all allies (the only passive in the team), and restore 100 energy for itself.
suits.name: Tracing

suits.attr_4_desc: When making a critical strike, sputter 30% of the damage to the enemy with the lowest max HP , CD: 5 seconds.
suits.name: Curse

suits.attr_4_desc: Generates a 3-second shield while resisting the negative state. CD: 12 seconds. Negative state duration is reduced by 20%.
suits.name: Astral

suits.attr_4_desc: No set bonus. The Oath Soul Stone itself provides a large amount of Horcrux experience, which can be used as experience props when strengthening other Horcruxes.
suits.name: Oath
